about: Shot list for the homepage preview (scripts/capture-preview.mjs). Each segment opens the simulation at a lesson, as a visitor would, and renders frames on its frame-stepped clock (?virt=1).

segments.name: expose
segments.about: The scanner steps and scans the wafer under the lens, with the light path shown.

setup.eval: window.__fabStores.useClock.setState({ progress: 0.3, playing: true, pendingPlay: false })

segments.name: develop
segments.about: Developer floods the wafer; the camera goes down into the layers as the exposed resist dissolves.

setup.eval: window.__fabStores.useApp.getState().answer('develop', { choice: 0, correct: true }); window.__fabStores.useClock.setState({ progress: 0.3, playing: true, pendingPlay: false })

segments.name: final
segments.about: The finished inverter under test: the input is switched to 1 and the output drops to 0.

setup.eval: window.__fabStores.useClock.setState({ progress: 0.4, playing: true, pendingPlay: false })

segments.name: explore
segments.about: Explore fab: the whole bay, then the camera travels to the scanner.
